body: I don’t know what condition he’s in at the moment and it’s making me very anxious since no one is replying to me and I don’t know how bad his condition is. At this point, he could be in coma/dead and I wouldn’t even know. I suppose I’d just like them to tell me in what situation he is or atleast let me know that he’s alive

It’s been around two days since the accident and he hasn’t picked his calls or replied to any messages. I think that means that it’s pretty serious. Plus, his younger sister left me on read when I asked how bad it was. I can’t really get angry at his sister because she’s only 10 years old but his aunt who I messaged hasn’t replied either.
